verdict.rationale: Lambda ships a live, key-gated REST API with a public OpenAPI 3.1 spec for creating and managing Lambda Cloud resources. Documented coverage includes instance launch, cloud-init, alternate base images and workspaces. However, several workflows are documented only through the console: reserving 1-Click Clusters, creating firewall rules on the Firewall page, viewing usage, and generating SSH keys. UI parity is therefore unproven, and the API appears to cover the core rather than everything. missing for 10: documented API equivalents for 1-Click Cluster reservation, firewall rule management, usage/billing views and SSH key generation, any explicit statement of UI/API parity, independent hands-on corroboration of full coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
the API allows you to use a different base image for your instance
the instance-provisioning REST API is live and key-gated
